proofs.text: Read every `why` value of that list and verify each is one of `unsigned`, `stale`, `held`, `needs a person` and `manual`, and that a rule whose only proof is `@manual` reads `manual`

rule_text: A review row's `why` is drawn from the closed set `unsigned`, `stale`, `held`, `needs a person` and `manual`, and `manual` replaces `needs a person` where a `@manual` proof is the cause
